verdict.rationale: Plaid is an API-first product. Its docs describe the Plaid API with concrete endpoints such as /sandbox/public_token/create, a fully featured Sandbox, programmatic webhooks, and an official Node SDK that calls methods like transactionsSync. The community comments concern privacy and scraping, not API availability, so they are ignored. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
